2026-10-23VACPension ActPensions and Allowances Annual Adjustment RegulationsPensions and Allowances Annual Adjustment Regulations in order to (1) express in more detail the rounding rule for the annual average consumer price index method; (2) set out the method for the Department to determine the average annual gross composite wage for unskilled members of the federal public service; (3) set out how to determine the income tax amount that is to be deducted from the average gross composite wage; and (4) set the rounding rule for the percentage increase to the basic pension before it is applied to the other pensions and allowances.Registration: SOR/2026-0226 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Pensions and Allowances Annual Adjustment Regulations
precis: Pensions and Allowances Annual Adjustment Regulations in order to (1) express in more detail the rounding rule for the annual average consumer price index method; (2) set out the method for the Department to determine the average annual gross composite wage for unskilled members of the federal public service; (3) set out how to determine the income tax amount that is to be deducted from the average gross composite wage; and (4) set the rounding rule for the percentage increase to the basic pension before it is applied to the other pensions and allowances.
